Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You tilt an invisible mirror. Your casting hand appears at the new angle, steadying the spell as you release it.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible unoccupied square within 6 squares with an unobstructed path from you.
Type
Magic / Utility

Place a casting point in the chosen square. Your next Main Action spell this turn may use that point for its attack path, cover and area origin, and gains 1 Boon to its attribute roll. Measure cast range from your own position. The point ends after that spell or at the end of your turn.
